newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina sees Aug tax revenue rise over last year.
newsitem.headline: Argentina sees Aug tax revenue rise over last year.

text.p: Argentina's tax collection is expected to be about $3.9 billion in August, up from $3.7 billion in August 1996, the Economy Ministry's taxation undersecretary Guillermo Rodriguez Use said Monday.
"This increase is due to an improvement in economic activity and in tax administration," he told reporters.
In July, tax collection grew to $4.15 billion, which was up 7.2 percent from July 1996 but fell short of the 15 percent rise the government anticipated.

However, Rodriguez Use said the tax collection figures remain on track with a level agreed under a standby pact with the International Monetary Fund. ((Patrick Adam/Jorge Iorio, Buenos Aires Newsroom, 541 318-0663))
